limitations: Exact S3A source is the cover STL only; no complete S3A board CAD found in official hardware tree ec351c516644b44defc145728cc029ced77381ff. Original cover triangles and rigid transform preserved.

Black PCB outline/thickness follow S3A drawing; holes/chamfers are photo estimates. Exact-SKU1200px backside photo covers known outer appearance; inward component layout remains UNKNOWN and is readable through public inspection separation.

USB/contact assembly, CHS-M2X3 screw and brass standoff reuse unscaled mechanical donor parts from official S007 STEP, checked against S3A drawing/photo. Exact supplier identity, hidden fit and thread remain unverified; donor PCB and old antenna are not used.
S3A U-shaped antenna visible face is photo-derived; hidden antenna structure, button internals, solder and electrical routing remain unknown. RGB position/height is photo-estimated.
Bare S007-V033 has no installed pin label or soldered optional headers. Supplied loose sticker, HY2.0 terminal, headers and hex key are not shown as installed parts.
Official dimensional scopes:26.0mm product nominal vs25.95mm drawing USB-inclusive and24mm body. Source dimensions remain unscaled. Photo color and appearance materials are not hardware-calibrated.
No physical hardware measurement or full firmware compatibility is established by this model.
assemblyNotes: Exact S3A cover STL retained with rigid Z−1.3mm transform. Photo/drawing-derived PCB and revised antenna; unscaled donor USB/M2 hardware at independently checked S3A coordinates, with explicit donor/hidden-fit limitations. No old S3 PCB or antenna substitution.

omittedComponents.reason: Old S3 PCB layout is not S3A; use explicit S3A photo/drawing placeholder.
S3A antenna changed; do not use old S3 antenna.
S3A exact cover STL replaces donor shield.

buttons.notes: Inside exact SKU shield cap, at CAD top plus 0.02 mm; physical button differs from base S3 and remains under this flexure.

inspectionGroups.notes: User inspection separation10mm along+Z; not a measured disassembly path. Inward UNKNOWN remains on the real PCB plane, metal standoff remains onboard.

derivedParts.label: UNKNOWN
derivedParts.notes: S3A drawing sets18x24mm outline and1mm thickness; chamfers and visible through-hole positions/radii estimated from exact SKU photo (+/-0.2mm). PCB Z seating is inferred at−2.3..−1.3mm. Black exposed underside is photo-covered; inward layout remains UNKNOWN. No trace/circuit reconstruction.
Masked official1200px backside photograph sits0.015mm below PCB; chamfers, actual holes and M2 hardware excluded. Printed appearance only; unknown internal layout remains on opposite face.
Exact S3A visible U-shaped antenna face traced from photo using18mm body; ±0.3mm planar/±0.5mm height estimate. Hidden conductive antenna and RF response unknown; old S3 antenna not reused.
Photo-estimated position under right lower slit, using documented18mm width; 1mm height not CAD-measured. No new light pipe/window.
Dark hexagonal visual mark over donor M2 head. Socket machining and hidden thread not certified; original donor screw solid remains unchanged.

revisions.changes: S3A revises antenna, boot button4.0×3.0×2.0mm and RGB power/backlight multiplexing; earlier S3 has2.6×1.6×0.55mm switch.
